caption:
Windows remembers more than your last copy. 📋

Press Windows key + V to open clipboard history. The first time, click Turn on. Then click any item to paste it.

Note: this is for Windows 10 and 11. 📌 Save this.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#windows #windows11 #shortcuts #productivity #keyboardshortcuts #computertips #lifehack #timesaver #techtips #techmendly

scenes.text: Copied something, then copied over it?
scenes.say: Copied something, then copied over it? Windows can bring it back.

scenes.title: Open clipboard history
scenes.say: Press the Windows key and V together.

scenes.title: Turn it on once
scenes.say: The first time, click turn on. After that, just copy as usual.

scenes.label: any item in the list to paste it
scenes.say: Later, press Windows and V again, and click any item in the list to paste it.

scenes.title: Don't copy passwords
scenes.body: Clear the history if you copy anything private.
scenes.say: One warning. Don't copy passwords, and clear the history if you copy anything private.
